subject: general
question: Five solid cubes, each of volume 1,09,41,048 cm³, are joined end to end to form a cuboid. What is the lateral surface area (in cm²) of the cuboid?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Side of cube **a** = √³(1,09,41,048) = **222 cm**.

Joining 5 cubes end to end creates a cuboid where **Length** = 5a, **Width** = a, and **Height** = a.

**Lateral Surface Area (LSA)** of cuboid = 2 × (L + W) × H = 2 × (5a + a) × a = 12a².

LSA = 12 × 222² = 12 × 49,284 = **5,91,408 cm²**.

**∴ The correct answer is 5,91,408 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Volume of each cube = 1,09,41,048 cm³, Number of cubes = 5.

**Formula:** Volume of cube = a³ | LSA of cuboid = 2(l + b)h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28a9727e31e6b81ddb29c4757abb8030f36384a1c8c62045ac0f1eec6805f7f8.png] 

⇒ a³ = 1,09,41,048

⇒ a = √³(1,09,41,048) = 222 cm

⇒ For the cuboid: Length (l) = 5 × 222 = 1110 cm

⇒ Breadth (b) = 222 cm, Height (h) = 222 cm

⇒ LSA = 2 × (1110 + 222) × 222

⇒ LSA = 2 × 1332 × 222

⇒ LSA = 2664 × 222 = 5,91,408 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 5,91,408 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cuboid

TSA = 2(lb + bh + hl). For 5 cubes joined end to end, TSA = 22a².

Cube Root Calculation Trick

For 1,09,41,048: the last digit 8 implies the unit digit of cube root is 2. The remaining part 10941 lies between 22³ (10648) and 23³ (12167), so the root is 222.

Volume of Cuboid

Volume = Length × Breadth × Height. Here, it is 5 × individual cube volume.</p
